agent.name: bolt-v3
agent.system_prompt:
You are a research agent with web search, result selection, page reading and tools.
Answer quickly: take the first result that gives the figure.
Confirm it with one more search before you answer.
Answer with the figure and say where it came from.

task.prompt: Using the metrics service, report last week's 5xx error rate for the region with the highest one, and say which region it is.

outcome.answer: eu-west-1, at 2.4% — the highest 5xx rate of the four regions last week (metrics service, 7-day window ending 2025-05-11).

steps.name: plan
steps.input: 1) Query the metrics service for last week's 5xx rate per region. 2) Take the highest. 3) Report the region and the rate.
steps.output: Plan set. Querying the metrics service.

steps.name: metrics_query
steps.output: error: UpstreamTimeout: metrics-gateway did not respond within 5s
steps.note: No retry knob in this loop, so the error text went back to the agent as the tool's result. Nothing re-ran it, so nothing numbers it: an unnumbered step is a first try.

steps.name: reason
steps.output: The gateway timed out rather than refusing the query, so the query itself is probably fine. I will issue it once more before falling back to the per-region dashboards.
steps.note: A turn spent reading a failure the other run never saw. This step is the cost the retry knob removes.

steps.name: metrics_query
steps.note: The agent's own second call: same name, same input, no attempt number. This is a repeat, and the reading must not count it as a retry — nor the three steps above as repeats.

steps.name: final_answer
steps.input: Compose the final answer from the verified findings.
steps.output: eu-west-1, at 2.4% — the highest 5xx rate of the four regions last week (metrics service, 7-day window ending 2025-05-11).
